steps.title: Analyze simple app requirements and plan layout
steps.description: Design a clean, lightweight interactive clicker and quote app called Simple Joy.

steps.title: Create application metadata configuration in app-meta.json
steps.description: Set up metadata file at the root containing app_name and package_name.

steps.title: Configure build.gradle with Gradle 8.5 and SDK 34
steps.description: Set up build environment with target SDK 34, min SDK 21, and compatible plugins.

steps.title: Create AndroidManifest.xml with correct namespace
steps.description: Configure permissions, application tag, main activity, and standard material theme without AndroidX dependency.

steps.title: Design the UI layout in activity_main.xml
steps.description: Create an elegant user interface using LinearLayout, ScrollView, custom buttons, card-like displays, and TextView elements.

steps.title: Implement MainActivity.java lifecycle and initialization
steps.description: Set up the Java package structure and class implementation for com.simplejoy.app.

steps.title: Implement clicker counter state logic
steps.description: Add an interactive click counter that increments when the main action button is pressed.

steps.title: Implement dynamic inspirational quote generator
steps.description: Store a selection of uplifting and simple quotes, displaying a new one upon interactive clicks.

steps.title: Implement dynamic background color changer
steps.description: Enable users to switch between delightful preset color palettes dynamically to make the app interactive and fun.

steps.title: Implement click counter reset options
steps.description: Add logic to reset click statistics and the background palette back to defaults.

steps.title: Ensure strict Java 8 compatibility
steps.description: Ensure the app uses anonymous inner classes for click events instead of lambdas or modern streams.

steps.title: Verify namespace validation and formatting
steps.description: Check AndroidManifest.xml and activity layouts to guarantee perfect standard-compliant XML attributes.

steps.title: Validate build setup cleanliness
steps.description: Confirm that no AndroidX, material, or external gradle dependencies are used, preventing compilation errors.

steps.title: Building Simple Joy
steps.description: Kick off the automated debug compilation task using Gradle 8.5 to generate the final APK.
